notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting6': ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents, Coruscant, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order and Mobilization Points, plus '---third depends on what they play---'; these count toward the 60. The third starting Effect is one of the six listed Effects ('Effects5 because one will be started'), so no starting effect is shown and the comment line has no row.
The deck totals 59 cards as published (section headers 6+19+3+10+4+2+5+10 also sum to 59).
The title and description say the deck was runner-up at the Ohio State Championship (2001 Ohio State Championship), 50-some players, 3-0 with this deck; the strategy says he finished 12 (+73).
